purpose: Teach: 寄稿/半角/尺/収まる/見逃せ/絞る/手すり/低め

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 専門誌、寄稿、私もチャンスください。
lines.en: I'd like a chance to contribute to the trade publication too.
lines.style: Direct, even-paced. A measured request — professional but with underlying confidence. No apology in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。エクセル、半角の入力ルール、改めて周知します。
lines.en: Got it. I'll make sure everyone knows the half-width input rules for Excel again.
lines.style: Steady, willing. Slight nod in the tone. Efficient, no hesitation — the cadence of someone taking notes mentally.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 動画、尺、十五秒バージョンも、欲しいわね。
lines.en: And I'll need a fifteen-second version of the video too.
lines.style: Businesslike, slightly clipped. A directive stated as expectation, not request. Brisk hand-motion feel.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。多忙が、ようやく収まる兆しです。
lines.en: Got it. The workload's finally starting to ease up.
lines.style: Quieter relief underneath. A small lift on 'finally' — not quite celebrating but allowing himself a breath. Genuine.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 今回のクレーム、見逃せない、しっかり対応してね。
lines.en: This complaint can't be overlooked — handle it properly.
lines.style: Firm but not unkind. Weight on 'can't be overlooked'. Expectation of competence, not doubt. Clear-eyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。候補を絞る作業、明日、完了します。
lines.en: Understood. I'll finish narrowing down the candidates tomorrow.
lines.style: Committed, no-nonsense. Quick clip on the closing. Acknowledging the deadline without drama.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 休憩室の手すり、修理、依頼済みです。
lines.en: I've already requested repairs for the break room handrail.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact update. Efficient — reporting what's done. Slight satisfaction of having checked it off.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。価格、競合より低めで、出します。
lines.en: Understood. I'll quote a price lower than the competitors'.
lines.style: Focused, final. Quiet conviction on the plan. No extra words — just commitment.
